file_insights.description: Complete removal of legacy views file containing 1236 lines of Django view functions for inventory management system

patterns_discovered.description: Single views.py file contained all inventory management views (dashboard, stock list, movements, warehouse, reservations, reports, etc.) indicating a refactoring from monolithic to modular architecture
All views used @login_required and some used @require_http_methods decorators, typical of traditional Django FBV patterns
Views extensively used select_related, prefetch_related, annotate with Q objects for filtering - sophisticated ORM usage but concentrated in one file
Some views returned JsonResponse for AJAX operations (warehouse_detail, create_movement) alongside HTML responses
Views contained substantial business logic including stock validation, reservations, movements, and reporting - not extracted to services or managers

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Large file deletion with no immediate replacement visible
gotchas_discovered.description: Removing 1236 lines of code without showing parallel implementation in other files could indicate incomplete refactoring or class-based views migration happening separately
Dashboard, stock management, warehouse management, reservations, and reporting all in one file - deletion suggests need for better separation of concerns
Some views returned both HTML and JSON depending on request headers - pattern suggests incomplete API separation
Complex ORM queries and business logic directly in views - deletion without showing new architecture could leave codebase in incomplete state

approach_outcome.description: Successfully deleted the old monolithic views.py file from apps/inventory/ directory
approach_outcome.execution_notes: File completely removed from repository in single commit ff0e153

recommendations.recommendation: Verify new view architecture is in place
recommendations.rationale: Deletion of 1236 lines of functional code requires confirmation that replacement views exist (likely as class-based views or in separate modules)

recommendations.recommendation: Check for broken imports across codebase
recommendations.rationale: Other modules likely imported functions from this views.py file - ensure all import statements have been updated to new locations

recommendations.recommendation: Extract business logic to services layer
recommendations.rationale: The complex QuerySet operations and stock validation logic should be moved to service classes or managers rather than kept in views

recommendations.recommendation: Separate API endpoints from HTML views
recommendations.rationale: AJAX endpoints returning JSON should be in separate API views/viewsets rather than mixed with HTML rendering views
After refactoring to new structure, document where different view categories (dashboard, stock, warehouse, reports) are now located
If implementing modern Django REST Framework, use ViewSets for consistent API structure instead of mixed FBV/CBV approaches
